items.headline: Brazil's Presidential Campaign Officially Kicks Off with Major Rival Rallies
items.summary: Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and rival candidate Flávio Bolsonaro officially launched their presidential campaigns on Sunday with massive rallies in São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro [1.4.2]. The upcoming vote in October will decide the political and economic direction of Latin America's largest nation.

items.headline: U.S. Pressures Global Partners to Choose Sides in AI Race with China
items.summary: The United States State Department has drafted letters warning international partner nations that they must choose between joining the U.S.-led AI coalition or China's competing initiative. This move aims to prevent sensitive technology sharing and secure critical supply chains as global competition over artificial intelligence intensifies.

items.headline: Arsenal Dominates Manchester City to Claim 2026 FA Community Shield
items.summary: Premier League champions Arsenal defeated Manchester City 3-0 at Cardiff's Principality Stadium on Sunday to win the 2026 FA Community Shield. The commanding victory delivered the first silverware of the English soccer season and marked a challenging competitive debut for new Manchester City manager Enzo Maresca.

items.headline: Spider-Man: Brand New Day Crosses $2 Billion at Global Box Office
items.summary: Sony and Marvel's Spider-Man: Brand New Day officially passed $2 billion at the global box office following its third weekend in theaters [1.2.5]. The blockbuster achieved the landmark milestone in record time, becoming only the eighth film in history to cross the two-billion-dollar threshold.
